extracted.intended_audience: researchers, innovators, companies, small businesses, and program teams seeking ARPA-H funding or partnering with ARPA-H
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on what kinds of projects ARPA-H seeks to fund: high-risk, high-reward health innovations that are transformational, broadly applicable, and not readily achievable through traditional research or commercial routes. Includes the programmatic emphasis on building programs and accelerating delivery to impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — solve the most significant health challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is simple: solve the most significant health challenges facing Americans today — the ones that are deemed too big, too complex, and too high-risk for traditional funding or industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At ARPA-H, we don’t just fund research — we build programs, remove barriers, and accelerate innovations that have the potential to change lives. Our ruthless pursuit of the impossible will create the healthcare solutions that are just waiting to exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target problem scope — too big, too complex, too high-risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should address problems that are 'too big, too complex, and too high-risk for traditional funding or industry.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARPA-H prioritizes work that cannot readily be accomplished through traditional research or commercial activity — i.e., high-risk/high-reward efforts requiring unusual investment or programmatic support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment focus — breakthrough technologies and broadly applicable platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H makes pivotal investments in breakthrough technologies and broadly applicable platforms, capabilities, resources, and solutions with the potential to transform important areas of medicine and health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for platforms and capabilities that are broadly applicable (not narrowly bespoke) and that can enable multiple downstream innovations or be reused across contexts; ARPA-H solutions aim to benefit everyone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformative impact — high-impact answers that change lives
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest in innovations with the potential to transform important areas of medicine and health and deliver the greatest impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on clear potential for large-scale health impact rather than incremental advances. News examples (e.g., programs to restore natural hearing, transform behavioral health) illustrate the level of ambition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scalability and reach — solutions that can reach everyone quickly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrate a credible path to rapid, wide adoption or distribution so that benefits reach large populations rather than limited niches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive health emphasis — preventing disease and dependency on care
rubrics_metrics.description: Proactive Health: Keeping people from being patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize approaches that shift care upstream toward prevention, early intervention, and maintenance of health rather than solely treating illness after onset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resilient systems — building integrated health care systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Resilient Systems: Building integrated health care systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support programs that strengthen systems-level integration, coordination, and resilience across care delivery, public health, and related infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health Science Futures — expand technical possibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Health Science Futures: Expanding what’s technically possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund cutting-edge scientific or technical advances that extend the frontier of what can be achieved in health science and enable new classes of interventions or tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic model — build programs, remove barriers, accelerate delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H emphasizes building programs, removing barriers, and accelerating innovations from concept to delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency’s model actively supports translation and delivery (e.g., enabling advancement 'from a mere concept to a delivered device in just a few years' per a Program Manager quote). Expect programmatic supports beyond traditional grants to speed progress and commercialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed and rapid translation — fast-tracking development to market
rubrics_metrics.description: A core expectation is accelerating innovations to market or deployment rapidly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Illustrated by news items (e.g., 'fast-tracks regenerative breakthroughs', 'small business awards set to bring revolutionary healthcare solutions rapidly to market') — proposers should show credible accelerated timelines and mechanisms for rapid translation.
